finiteSupport.interpretation: Support cell is gameplay occupancy, not a solid full-floor ground footprint. Keep empty z0, root and finite lowest lower-rail patch. Native fullfloor or dropped base would invent ground contact.

clearanceAndEnvelope.hardDerived: Three finite port patches at x ±.5; original repeat clears neighboring cells because all geometry x is within ±.5 and y -.237...26. Geometry never reaches z0. Endpoint collar x[-.5,-.35] and [.35,.5] is free of ribs/plates, contains only these continuous rail extrusions.
clearanceAndEnvelope.proposedRootFreeze: Preserve source port profiles, finite lowest lower-rail patch and no geometric z0 contact. Use measured finite source outer convex hull as a conservative outer-envelope proposal (explicit root freeze needed); .78 remains nominal catalog height rather than measured geometry. Interior construction and decoration may change meaningfully inside it. Source part counts, source per-part boxes and blank bays are not automatically functional constraints.
clearanceAndEnvelope.limits: Empty bay probes establish the original construction only; they do not lock weak blank areas. No collider mesh or explicit gameplay subcell free-space contract was supplied. The proposed hull is an upper envelope, not a requirement to fill it or a source occupied solid. AABB alone cannot certify unchanged finite contact or port geometry. Editor must use actual mesh-plane/cross-section checks, not infer a volume grant from nominal 1x1x.78.

sourceOuterConvexHull.purpose: Measured finite conservative outer envelope proposal, not source occupied solid or approved admissible interior volume.
sourceOuterConvexHull.convention: Inside if normal dot point + constant <= 1e-6 for every hull plane.
